properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate The organization conducts regular and comprehensive testing of its contingency plan, including checklists, tabletop exercises, simulations, and full recovery simulations, to ensure effectiveness and readiness during disasters or emergencies, and documents and addresses any identified weaknesses or gaps. (Data-Security-74).

metadata.Description:
The organization conducts regular and comprehensive testing of its contingency plan, including checklists, tabletop exercises, simulations, and full recovery simulations, to ensure effectiveness and readiness during disasters or emergencies, and documents and addresses any identified weaknesses or gaps.
Test the contingency plan for the information system to determine the effectiveness of the plan and the organizational readiness to execute the plan. Conduct tests initially and periodically (frequency determined by organization) using checklists, walk-through and tabletop exercises, simulations, and comprehensive exercises. Review the contingency plan test results, initiate corrective actions, and update the plan as needed.
